question: Question of the Day: Imagine that from now on, you can only say things you genuinely believe. It does not have to be objectively true. What would you do?

options.text: Continue as usual, because obviously I have never lied in my entire life.
Keep my genuine thoughts to myself in certain situations to avoid a genuine punch to the face.
Try to gaslight myself until I genuinely believe my own lies.
Train myself to become pure, rational, neutral, and objective, like a lab report.
Refuse to answer this question, because I never let people to know my genuine thoughts.
Develop very advanced facial expressions and hope people understand.
Have another brilliant strategy and will share it in the group chat.
